task_context.problem_statement: In a town, there is a multi-story parking lot, which has room for 425 cars. The parking lot has 5 levels, each of the same size. How many more cars can one level fit if there are already 23 parked cars on that level?
task_context.reference_solution:
When all levels are empty, each level can fit 425 / 5 = <<425/5=85>>85 cars.
When there are already 23 parked cars on a level, there is still a place for 85 - 23 = 62 cars.
#### 62
